exercises.title: Document Anatomy & Meta Tags
exercises.description: Build a valid HTML5 document shell with UTF-8 encoding and viewport configuration.
exercises.theory: Every modern HTML5 document requires a <!DOCTYPE html> declaration to trigger standards mode. The <head> block manages metadata, encoding, page title, and viewport scaling.
exercises.objective: Create a standards-compliant HTML document with meta tags, title, and body elements.

exercises.title: Forms: Text Inputs & Labels

</svg>

exercises.title: SEO Metadata & OpenGraph Protocols
exercises.description: Configure head metadata for social media preview cards and search engine indexing.
exercises.theory: Search engines and social sharing portals parse meta tags (description, canonical links, og:title, og:image) to display link preview cards.
exercises.objective: Build a complete head metadata block for social media link sharing.
exercises.initialCode:
<head>
    <!-- Add SEO and OpenGraph meta tags -->
</head>
exercises.solutionCode:
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <title>ByteCode - Full Stack Engineer Path</title>
    <meta name="description" content="Master software engineering with interactive code challenges.">
    <link rel="canonical" href="https://bytecode.dev/courses/html">
    <!-- Open Graph Metadata -->
    <meta property="og:title" content="ByteCode - Full Stack Engineer Path">
    <meta property="og:description" content="Interactive developer platform for building web apps.">
    <meta property="og:image" content="https://bytecode.dev/og-banner.png">
    <meta property="og:type" content="website">
</head>
requirements: Include description meta tag
Add canonical link tag
Add og:title, og:description, og:image, and og:type meta tags
hints: og: meta tags use property attribute instead of name
